Owner-only action, unchecked approval and disabled submit. Revalidate eligibility, retry budget and application idempotency immediately before execution. Confirmation job only; never replay payment. Application owns duplicate prevention; no exactly-once guarantee. Prevent duplicate submits; record actor/time/scope. Transition accepted→executing→pending verification; a queue acknowledgement is not success. Block unsupported/incomplete evidence and explain why.
